title: Abelian section rows and coproduct total of a pro-etale simplicial object
statement: For a scheme X, a pro-etale object W and a simplicial object U over W [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], define sections of an abelian sheaf in simplicial degree p to be its sections at U_p. Form the alternating coface cochain complex and extend it by zero to negative simplicial degrees. For an integer cochain complex of abelian sheaves, apply this row construction degreewise, flip the bicomplex and take its coproduct total [def-sp-double-complex-total]. The differential is the alternating restriction differential plus (-1)^p times the coefficient differential.
